text: Raw lap-time slopes hide degradation because fuel burn makes the car faster every lap. Clean the laps, fuel-correct them, then fit each stint.

title: Fuel-corrected degradation by stint
preview:
# Fuel-corrected degradation by stint
from backend.f1lab.pace import clean_laps, fuel_correct, fit_degradation
laps = load('laps_11388_44.json')
total = max(l['lap_number'] for l in laps)
colors = ['#3d7f8a', '#d9822b', '#7a5aa6']
series = []
for i, stint in enumerate(sorted({l['stint'] for l in laps if l['stint'] is not None})):
    s = [l for l in laps if l['stint'] == stint]
    cl = clean_laps(s)
    raw = fit_degradation(cl, min_laps=5)
    fx_laps = fuel_correct(cl, total)
    fx = fit_degradation(fx_laps, min_laps=5)
    if not (raw and fx):
        continue

text: Sanity-check the slopes and measure the pit stops before reporting anything.

title: Sanity checks and pit stops
preview:
# Sanity checks and pit stops
from backend.f1lab.pace import clean_laps, fuel_correct, fit_degradation
from backend.f1lab.pit import pit_losses
from backend.f1lab.sanity import check_degradation, check_pit_loss
laps = load('laps_11388_44.json')
total = max(l['lap_number'] for l in laps)
for stint in sorted({l['stint'] for l in laps if l['stint'] is not None}):
    fx = fit_degradation(fuel_correct(clean_laps([l for l in laps if l['stint'] == stint]), total), min_laps=5)
    if fx:
        print(f"stint {stint}: degradation checks ->", [i.code for i in check_degradation(fx.slope_s_per_lap, fuel_corrected=True)] or 'plausible')
for p in pit_losses(laps, total):
    loss = 'n/a (not green)' if p.loss_s is None else f"{p.loss_s:.1f} s"
    print(f"stop L{p.lap_in}-L{p.lap_out} [{p.condition}] pit loss {loss}", [i.code for i in check_pit_loss(p.loss_s, p.condition)] or 'plausible')

markdown:
**Hamilton's degradation at Singapore was mild on the Medium and clear on the Soft:** about **+0.05 s/lap** on the Medium (weak fit) and **+0.11 s/lap** on the Soft (good fit), after correcting for fuel burn.

| Stint | Compound | Clean laps | Raw slope | Fuel-corrected | R² |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Medium | 14 | −0.005 s/lap | **+0.045 s/lap** | 0.23 |
| 2 | Soft | 39 | +0.062 s/lap | **+0.112 s/lap** | 0.72 |

**Why the raw numbers mislead.** The car burns fuel every lap, so it gets faster by roughly as much as the tyres get slower. On the Medium the raw slope is almost flat (−0.005 s/lap) and would suggest no degradation at all. Removing the fuel effect shows the tyre was in fact losing about 0.05 s/lap.

**Pit stop.** One green-flag stop, lap 18 to 19, measured at **22.5 s** of pit loss, which sits in the normal range.

**Assumptions and uncertainty**
- The fuel effect of 0.05 s per lap of fuel is an **assumption**, not a measurement. A different value moves both slopes by the same amount.
- Stint 1 has a low R² (0.23): treat +0.045 s/lap as indicative, not precise.
- Lap 1, in/out laps, safety-car and virtual-safety-car laps and slow outliers were excluded.
- One driver in one race: this says nothing about his teammate or other circuits.
